h1: Relief rally: hedges expired, then re-set
sub: S&P +1.6%, Nasdaq +0.9% (it faded from +2.3%), Russell +1.5%. The election puts bought Tuesday lost about 90%. Today the November protection was moved, not dropped: up and out to December in the Russell, down and back to the money in the S&P.

trades.note: put bought, call sold Tuesday: a ~$4.6B synthetic short
fresh at-the-money protection, 90% at the ask
near-money hedge sold, cheaper ones bought
monthly hedge stepped up again, to ~4% below
one package at 15:24: out a month and $5 up; ~$9M net
cheap event calls; 2–3× at the 09:45 high, below entry by the close

read: Read: the event hedges did their job and expired. The rally didn't end hedging; it moved it. Russell protection followed the price up, and late a 30k-lot went out to December. S&P protection went cheaper below and fresh at the money. One big December call sale capped Nasdaq upside. Same-day delta was −$17B on a +1.6% day: volatility sold, not a bearish bet. Positioning, not a signal.
mon: Side from ask/bid, inferred · open interest is start-of-day · left out: SPX 7000/8000 box legs and deep in-the-money legs
